subject: general
question: What will ₹80,000 amount to in one year at 12% per annum, if the interest is compounded half-yearly?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹80,000

Rate (r) = 12% per annum

Time (t) = 1 year

Interest is compounded half-yearly

**Formula used:**

A = P(1 + (r)/(2 times 100))²t
